item: The permanent-outage endpoint test patches the module the worker imports and stops any worker an earlier test left running; a second run never starts beside a running one (pinned)
summary: Windows shard 2 read 'running' after a job that stopped at 10 failures while the test patched 2: the patched constants were not the ones the worker read, so the real backoff outran join(5). The test now patches the sys.modules copy, joins up to 60 s and names a live worker; _reset cancels and joins a leftover worker before blanking state. The product already refused a second start; a new test pins it. Tests only.
